ADR 0028/0016: cumulative successful engine-owned SDL GPU canvas graphics-pipeline creations during the active renderer session. Cache hits do not increment; cache retirement and failed later frames retain successful work. Initialization contributes before first frame; closure returns zero and a new session starts afresh. Compatibility owns no such pipeline objects and returns zero. Atomic managed reads do not create/synchronize native state; local-device graphics, compute/physics, import and driver-internal compilation are separate. See docs/components/canvas-counters.md#canvas-pipeline-compilation.
